messages:
Hana (AE): Deal-desk ask: Vela Industries wants a 12mo Dedicated commit. List = $720,000/yr. They asked for 33% off, net45, and a one-time onboarding credit of 4 weeks. They claim they'll be a case-study and plan to double usage year 2. Need quick guidance—customer wants yes/no by EOD.

Omar (Finance): 33% sits in the exception band. What net number and any payment security? Also need estimated incremental cost.

Hana (AE): Net = $482,400/yr. No prepay proposed. They offered a signed PO from an operating subsidiary. Sales suggests 30% + 30% deposit if we want to avoid CFO step.

Luca (Sales Ops): Numbers: list 720k -> 30% = 504k, 33% = 482.4k. Estimated incremental cost ~120k. Margin still OK at 30%+. Recommend require 30% deposit for anything >25% discount. Also add renewal guardrail so discount doesn't auto-apply on renewal.

Riley (Legal): We can accept onboarding credit if capped and scope-limited. Net45 OK if signatory verified; add late fee language. Also require IP and integration scoping separate from discount. Legal turnaround ~48 hrs for redlines.

Omar (Finance): For Marin: finance can approve up to 30% with a 30% non-refundable deposit and credit check OK. 31-35% requires CFO sign-off and at least 30% deposit + collections OK. Anything above 35% needs exec committee.

Hana (AE): I'll push for 30% deposit and ask them to accept net30. If they insist on 33% we'll need Marin. Customer says they can do 30% deposit but not net30.

Marin (CFO): I can approve 33% on a one-off if all of the following are met: (1) 30% upfront non-refundable deposit, (2) collections approves net45 for the buyer entity after credit check, (3) Legal signs off on onboarding credit cap & liability language, and (4) margin floor after incremental costs >= 40%. If any condition fails, cap discount at 30% with deposit. Document conditions in the deal ticket.

Omar (Finance): Noted. Hana, add deposit term and credit check to the ticket and tag me once collection sign-off is attached.

Hana (AE): Will do. Thanks all — I'll confirm deposit today and loop back. :thumbsup:
